name: Cashverse staking distributor public depositBNB swaps with no minimum output
summary: Unverified staking/reward distributor 0x2d70d62d held 225.995 BNB. Its public depositBNB() (0x42220f34) swaps the whole BNB balance for ADAcash through PancakeSwap with amountOutMin 0 once any stake exists. The attacker flash-borrowed 12,000 WBNB and pushed up the ADAcash price with 53 maximum-size buys. It then called depositBNB() and sold into the inflated pair, capturing the distributor's BNB.

loss.notes: Exact native BNB depletion of distributor 0x2d70d62deb1cb9918ff6be7bb5d173e8cd4ad854, recorded as the wrapped-BNB address and valued at the DefiLlama WBNB quote. The attacker's flash-loaned WBNB and buys are circular. The EOA's BNB balance rose by 150.36 BNB across the block; the rest went to pools and fees. The candidate figure of USD 107.9k is not this gross measure.

ageReset.description: Owner 0x2198c955's enterStaking(10000e18) (0x41441d3b) wrote the first nonzero total stake (slot 7) into the distributor. It had been dormant since 2021 with 225.985 BNB. Before this write, depositBNB() returned without swapping; from this block on it swaps the full BNB balance with zero minimum. The runtime is unchanged since 2021 deployment.

limitations: The distributor has no verified source; selector names come from the public signature database. The missing caller check and zero minimum are established from the trace (an attacker contract created in the same block was served; router call swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin 0). The age basis is established from debug_traceCall simulations and the slot-7 write, not from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. In source-1 (block 46458991, index 2), EOA 0x565986cc calls contract 0xc011232f (created in the same block, 0x0ea27910...) with d2e77c77(53, 12000e18, distributor, ADAcash 0x651a89fed302227d41425235f8e934502fb94c48). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows flash loans of 6431.52 WBNB from 0x172fcd41 and 5568.48 WBNB from 0x36696169, unwrapped. There are 53 router buys (b6f9de95, 1015.81 BNB in total), each returning about 5e29 ADAcash from pair 0x504d67fe989eed20871551f961071b1275fdd17b, and a 10984.19 BNB buy of ADA (0x3ee2200e) from 0x28415ff2. The attacker then calls distributor.depositBNB() (0x42220f34). The distributor calls router 0x10ed43c7 swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(amountOutMin 0, [WBNB, ADAcash], to itself) with value 225995266371155725731, receiving 390929772214361160699875631237 ADAcash. The attacker then sells ADAcash (791ac947) and ADA back and repays. Simulation (debug_traceCall, from 0x...beef) of depositBNB at block 46458990 reaches the same swap and reverts in the pair (Pancake: TRANSFER_FAILED): without the pump the swap cannot complete. A competing attempt, 0x61b31f6cb17243381b4cd2be57897b40e0ca11ad426b3e8b8316a5f77dbd7cde (block 46458990, from 0x983f2c0b), reverted. Identity/age: eth_getCode is empty at 13093221. keccak at 13093222 and 46458990 is the recorded hash (12523 bytes, no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT). Source-2 (index 162) is a top-level creation by 0x25053932 whose receipt contractAddress is the distributor. Admin review: Etherscan txlist for the distributor, blocks 0..latest, has 18 transactions: creation; transferOwnership to 0x2198c955 (43795251); unauthorize(0x25053932); setStakingToken/setEarnHub to 0x3279c595 (43795324/43795331) and then to EHB 0x98bd51d6 (43796941/43796962); enterStaking(10000e18) twice (43797081, 43798203); setSwapperExcluded; authorize(0x98bd51d6), authorize(0x2198c955); transferOwnership to 0x042469a1 (43825236); authorize(self); excludeFromProcess(true/false) (43825796/43825837); setSwapperExcluded. Simulated depositBNB makes no external call at blocks 13094007, 30000000, 43795250, 43795324, 43795331, 43796941 and 43796962. From 43797081 onward (checked at every later admin block and at 43900000/45000000) it calls the router with the full balance. prestateTracer(diffMode) of source-4 changes only slot 7 (0 to 10000e18) and one mapping slot. That first stake is therefore the age reset. Earliest exercise: Etherscan txlistinternal for the distributor returns only two outgoing value transfers, the reverted 46458990 attempt and source-1. BNB balance is 225.985266371155725731 from block 13094007 to 43795250 and 225.995266371155725731 at 46458990.

Reviewed loss. eth_getBalance(distributor) is 225995266371155725731 wei at block 46458990 and 0 at 46458991. callTracer shows the full amount leaving in the source-1 router call, the distributor's only value transfer in the block. BNB is valued at the DefiLlama WBNB quote (source-7).
